extracted.name: Milk Banana Smoothie
extracted.description: Milk, bananas, and a pinch of sweetener are all you need for this creamy, smooth drink.
ingredient_lines: 5 (1 gram) packets low calorie granulated sugar substitute (such as Sweet 'n Low®)
